name: thung_chai_edits
sources: A basket boat of the coast of Việt Nam (thúng chai): 1.8 m across (insideasiatours.com, Vietnam's basket boats: 1.8 m or 2.2 m) and about 0.6 m deep (from photos). Strips of bamboo, woven flat and pressed to the shape; a rim of bamboo hoops; a coat of resin. It is from edits only (plan 0011): no code of World knows this kind of model. It is not a copy of a real thing.
